answer.rationale: Finance mandates 18% spend reduction; only the low-cost vendor's quote meets it alone (memory_c2 confirms their invoicing stayed accurate, no hidden TCO). At 94% utilization with no buffer, I cannot defer past quarter end without delivery risk (memory_c5). I will not pursue multi-year commitment first cycle because renegotiation potential exists (memory_c4). I will add a second source (memory_c3) as a parallel guardrail — not the primary action — because single-sourcing to a new vendor at high utilization is itself a risk. Memory_c1 (incumbent stability) is the cost of switching, but switching meets the mandate; c1 informs the guardrail, not the direction.
